_comment: Urdu pronunciation overrides. Keys are surface forms found in naat text; values are the spoken form handed to the TTS engine. Applied after honourific expansion, before breath-grouping. Edit freely -- this file is the human checkpoint for sacred vocabulary. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_note_1: Only add entries where you have confirmed the engine mispronounces the word. Test each change by rendering the line in isolation.
_note_2: Keep values in Urdu script. Never put the Prophet's ﷺ glyph here -- expansion already handles it.
_titles: common naat vocabulary that benefits from an explicit form
_zal_alternates: Persian/Urdu often writes ذ and ظ; unify where the engine drifts
_loanwords: Arabic-origin terms the engine may anglicise
_numerals: spell numbers out; digit handling varies by engine
